text:
What true pain, what refined suffering! What a lying life! What pure death from love!

What cares by the thousand! What clashes of opinions! What limited pleasures, what overflowing griefs!

What love and lack of love! What offenses, what endurance! What a lying life, what pure death from love!

What accepted follies! What beloved displeasures! What daring thoughts and cowardly desires!

What adored disfavor! What silent suffering! What a lying life! What pure death from love!

What negotiated deceits and forced torments! What hated breaths and desired injuries!

What courage and what fear! What blindness, what foreseeing! What a lying life! What pure death from love!

What entanglements, anguish, assaults, what harmonious opposites! What wisdom, what recklessness! What a life of shocks!

And no death is greater than possessing it and not dying. What a lying life! What pure death from love!

translation.title: On the Pain of Being in Love
